source.title: SG-11 | Real Supplier portal and minimal Admin review, plus PO/ready integration
source.body:
**Outcome:** operators perform everything from UI, not manual DB/Swagger/console.

**Supplier Business UI:** only (1) Requests/PO and (2) My Products & Prices. Own offers with actual purchase cost/reported quantity/unknown, upload Full/Partial and coverage, stored profile, first-time mapping approval if authorized, parsed/skip/invalid counts, before-after exceptions, apply job, row-history errors and retry; server state not decorative. Allow manual corrections/offer update. Supplier can only view own data; no customer PII/margin/other supplier costs. PO consolidates by SKU, full/partial/unavailable/price-changed, safe award/binding outcome, ready only after awarded commitment (not Hub Received); verify data propagation into sourcing and future stock signal.

**Admin minimal catalog review:** one contextual review surface for pending Candidate/Brand/Line/Ingredient/Media/Publish decisions (no full Admin dashboard expansion). Arabic RTL mobile and desktop, loading empty unauthorized stale 409 retry and file error states; accessibility.

**Acceptance:** fully logged-in supplier imports and verifies real DB changes; owner reviews and publishes candidate; browser refresh persists; wrong-supplier access 403; draft not binding; 2 browser roles and responsive smoke. Cross-link AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#2/115/124/207.

**Execution dependency:** blocked by AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#141. Complete and review previous gate before starting this stage.

### Supplier manual returns / credits — complete only the necessary operational seam

Reuse existing supplier payable / financial reconciliation contracts (see AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#17 and AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#124). Within contextual PO/Supplier and Finance actions, verify that a Hub-accepted customer return sent **physically** to the same supplier with the next purchase delivery is recorded as `SupplierReturn` pending; supplier confirmation yields a verified `SupplierCredit`; applying the credit to the next invoice is a separate, auditable action. Do NOT treat handed-off return as accepted monetary credit, double-deduct purchase COGS, or lower the new PO's genuine gross acquisition cost. Show gross new supplier invoice, credit applied, actual cash paid distinctly. Record a disputed/rejected credit and monthly cutover. If existing APIs cannot support this, report a focused contract gap and add the smallest required API/conditional UI; avoid a separate Returns portal or full accounting suite. Acceptance: supplier next bill 600 EGP minus verified old credit 100 EGP = 500 cash paid, **new goods acquisition cost remains 600**. Backlink to supplier invoice/return and monthly statement.
